verdict.rationale: An IP office's digital services could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled trade-mark watches or auto-renewal, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows manual online or postal filing, manual search, and a 'Track a trade mark' link. The 'Get emails' subscription is a gov.uk platform notification feature, not a user-configurable automation the IPO itself provides, so it earns no credit. Nothing documents user-defined automations running autonomously.
